purpose: Promote the V72 coupled synthetic ecosystem from CI scale toward 1e5-5e5 cell stress execution without changing its scientific semantics.
central_rule: Generate one sharded master hidden truth first. Every observable dataset must be a deterministic observation of those truth shards; independent per-dataset truth generation is forbidden.

FULL.role: final production dry run only after stress qualification

master_truth.cell_identity: stable global cell_index plus deterministic cell_id
master_truth.shard_independence: truth values are generated deterministically from global cell ranges and frozen seeds; output is invariant to shard size/order
master_truth.truth_firewall: hidden_truth shards are physically separate from observable outputs and never referenced by observable manifests

full104_observer.output: column-sharded RNA counts plus availability and metadata

resource_gate.qualification: measured CI-scale bytes/cell must be compared with analytical estimate before promotion to 1e5 cells
